You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def solve(g):
    n=len(g); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # band rows or cols (solid 3s)
    band_rows=[r for r in range(n) if all(v==3 for v in g[r])]
    band_cols=[c for c in range(n) if all(g[r][c]==3 for r in range(n))]
    # period P: spacing of pattern slots = region+1. Find via separator lines of all-0 crossing pattern area.
    # derive from tile starts: first 2 cell gives tile origin (0,0)? assume tile starts at first 2's block start
    first=None
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            if g[r][c]==2: first=(r,c); break
        if first: break
    # find vertical/horizontal period from zero separator lines
    P_r = next(r for r in range(first[0]+1,n) if all(g[r][c]==0 for c in range(n)))  # first full-zero row after
    P_c = next(c for c in range(first[1]+1,n) if all(g[r][c]==0 for r in range(n) if r not in band_rows))
    L=P_r+1
    # template: positions within tile = (r%P_r, c%P_c) for pattern cells; T size (P_r)x(P_c)? region rows = P_r-1? 
    # Actually region size = P_r-1? demo1: P_r=5, region rows 4. tile rows 0..P_r-2? but shape may touch? use region=P-1
    H, W = P_r-1, P_c-1
    br0 = first[0] - (first[0] % P_r) if first[0]%P_r < H else None
    bc0 = first[1] - (first[1] % P_c)
    T=[[g[br0+i][bc0+j] if br0+i<n and bc0+j<n else 0 for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    if band_rows:
        r0=band_rows[0]
        # free axis = cols, paste at slot index 1: c = P_c
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if T[i][j]: out[r0+i][P_c+j]=T[i][j]
        for r in band_rows:
            for c in range(n):
                if out[r][c]==3: out[r][c]=0
    else:
        c0=band_cols[0]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if T[i][j]: out[P_r+i][c0+j]=T[i][j]
        for c in band_cols:
            for r in range(n):
                if out[r][c]==3: out[r][c]=0
    # 8 lattice: multiples of L; value 8 iff template position says 2
    for r in range(0,n,L):
        for c in range(0,n,L):
            if T[r%P_r][c%P_c]==2: out[r][c]=8
    return out
